title: chore(scripts): the root type-check program reaches zero errors; delete the obsolete analytics-reconcile harness
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi95T4eukLFQZWx7jmjMoEvhv)_
Part of #26236

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this does

The workspace root's own type-check program (`tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`) goes from 26 errors to 0. This is Wanted 1 of the card only. The `@objectstack/spec-monorepo` DEBT entry stays in this PR on purpose; Wanted 2 and 3 land together in a second PR on this branch (see "Why Wanted 2 is not here").

| Errors on `origin/main` 3d50a43b (closure built) | Fix in this PR |
|:---|:---|
| 17 × TS2307 + 7 × TS7006 in `scripts/analytics-reconcile/` | delete the tree (below) |
| 1 × TS2550, `Object.hasOwn` in `scripts/check-test-typecheck.mts` | root `tsconfig.json` sets `lib: ["ES2022"]`; the scripts run on Node 22 or later (root `engines`), which ships all of ES2022. The shared `tsconfig.base.json` stays at ES2020 |
| 1 × TS6133, unused `const task` in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/reports/index.ts` | delete the const |

No type rule is loosened: no `skipLibCheck` change, no `exclude` change, no strict flag touched.

## Why `scripts/analytics-reconcile/` is deleted rather than resolved

The card named two routes for its imports. Both were measured, and neither holds:

1. **A root workspace devDependency** (`@objectstack/runtime`, `objectql`, `driver-sqlite-wasm`, `service-analytics`, `spec`). Measured: after `pnpm install`, the workspace root joins every dependents filter of those packages. `pnpm --filter '...@objectstack/service-analytics' run check:node-version` ran the root's own script in `.`. So a consumer sweep such as `pnpm --filter '...@objectstack/spec' typecheck` would also start the root's `typecheck` / `test`, which are repo-wide turbo runs.
2. **Move the tree under `packages/qa/dogfood`**, which already depends on all five. Once the imports resolve, the 7 TS7006 turn out to be hiding 31 real errors in `reconcile.ts` (26 × TS2339, 1 × TS2551, 4 × TS7006). The harness reads the widget keys `object`, `categoryField`, `categoryGranularity`, `valueField`, `aggregate`, `measures` and the report keys `objectName`, `groupingsDown`. The spec removed all of them at the ADR-0021 single-form cutover. The widget schema refuses the widget keys with a prescription (`LEGACY_WIDGET_ANALYTICS_KEYS` in `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`), and `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts` records the inline `objectName` + `columns` + `groupings` report query as removed.

The tree is the read-only dual-form reconciliation harness of ADR-0021 Phase 1: it compares a widget's inline query with its dataset binding. ADR-0021 records the cutover that deleted the inline form as merged, so no widget has a legacy half left to compare. The runners also could not start on `main`: four imports named example files that have moved (`app-showcase/src/{dashboards,datasets,reports}` now live under `src/ui/`) or been deleted (the CRM `sales-by-stage` report). No script, workflow, package or doc invokes the tree.

The deleted files are kept in history at commit 3d50a43bcb55053e0501d939b304242b41cfde19 (`scripts/analytics-reconcile/`).

## In-place fix the deletion forces

`scripts/check-whole-set-label-write.mjs`: the six deleted files were the last tracked `.ts` files under `scripts/`, so the `'scripts/**/*.ts'` entry of `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` reached no file. Its `--self-test` POPULATION case ("every declared hint reaches a file this gate walks") went red at exit 1. This PR removes that one entry, as the gate's own docblock prescribes for an extension the tree does not hold. After the change, `--self-test` and the scan both exit 0. The claim's file surface was amended to include this file.

## Why Wanted 2 is not here

Deleting the DEBT entry cannot land green without Wanted 3's `.github/workflows/lint.yml` step:

- `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` around L2814: once the root declares `typecheck:root`, the gate reports a finding unless `lint.yml` invokes it. `ciInvokesRoot` is `/typecheck:root/.test(lintYml)` (around L4867).
- Without `typecheck:root`, deleting the entry reports "no `typecheck:root` script and no ledger entry".
- An entry recording 0 is refused by the structural half.

So the entry, the script and the workflow step move together, in one Tier H PR that waits for an authorized approval. Until then, the re-measure reports the root as a graduation candidate ("DEBT records 26, and tsc now reports 0") and prints the 26-error surplus, which is never red.

## Acceptance

- Root `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`: exit 0, 0 errors at d4dc23c0 (26 at 3d50a43b with the closure built).
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt` (self-test, then `--re-measure` under the verify lock): exit 0. Re-measure line: "0 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number".
- `node scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`: exit 0.
- `examples/app-showcase` `tsc --noEmit`: exit 0.
- Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 62 derived, 62 run at d4dc23c0, every one exit 0. `--ran` verdict: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 62 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". One deviation: `check:pm-dispatch-gates` ran its fast tier (1917 cases, exit 0); the slow tier was not run. It spawns scripts by path, and `git grep analytics-reconcile` finds no caller anywhere in the repository, so no slow-tier case can reach the deleted files.

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/check-logger-receiver-detach.mjs` has a docblock that counts "six under `scripts/analytics-reconcile/`" among the tracked `.ts` files outside its scan roots. That count is now stale. The gate's scan is green and the comment carries no assertion, so it is left as it is.
- The DEBT entry's `note` and the `ROOT_PROGRAM_COUPLED_SCRIPT` comment in `check-type-check-coverage.mjs` still describe the 26. Both go in the Wanted 2+3 PR, which deletes the entry.
- `ui/docs/audits/2026-09-plugin-detail-downstream-consumer-census.md` cites `scripts/analytics-reconcile/macros.ts` in the hotcrm repository, not this one. It is unaffected.
- `docs/adr/0021-analytics-dataset-semantic-layer.md` and `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` describe the reconciliation harness in the past tense, as history. Neither names the path, and neither is changed.

Changeset: none. The diff touches the root program, root `scripts/` and a private example (`@objectstack/example-showcase`), so nothing publishes. Labelled `skip-changeset`.
